sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-27 and 2016-11-27, suspicious transaction activity totaling $39.08 was identified on card C02354-K2 owned by customer C02354. Activity matched the 'card_not_present_new_device' typology. The primary transaction was conducted via the in_person channel. The cardholder verified unauthorized activity. The compromise connects to 1203 other card(s) through shared device profiles. Immediate mitigation including card blocking and downstream monitoring was enacted in accordance with bank policy.
